notes.title: English Update Now Live for Love's Sweet Garnish 2!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for your patience. The English language update for Love's Sweet Garnish 2 is now live. If the update hasn't been pushed to your Steam client already be sure to turn on automatic updates or press the update button in the client.

In celebration of the update, we're also putting both games on sale! If you've been on the fence about picking up this series then now's the perfect time to do so! The sale will run from [b]March 15, 10:00 AM PST to March 22, 10:00 AM PST[/b] so don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/891510/Loves_Sweet_Garnish/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1419480/Loves_Sweet_Garnish_2/
